title: Well control barrier verification
description: Verify each barrier element independently — mud column, casing and cement, BOP and wellhead, and integrity envelope — and hard-stop the operation if any one is unproven.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-well-02
  title: Well control barrier verification
  description: Verify each barrier element independently — mud column, casing and cement, BOP and wellhead,
    and integrity envelope — and hard-stop the operation if any one is unproven.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Proceed only with two independently verified barriers between the reservoir and the environment,
    with an unverified element treated as absent rather than as presumed intact. This workflow structures
    verification for accountable well-site personnel; it does not authorize any operation.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-authority-1
      - n-authority-2
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Well state and barrier test records
      summary: Well state and barrier test records
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - well_state
              - barrier_test_records
              - mud_program
              - annulus_pressures
              - operation_step
            properties:
              well_state: {}
              barrier_test_records: {}
              mud_program: {}
              annulus_pressures: {}
              operation_step: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: n-barrier1
      kind: agent
      templateRef: well-03
      name: Primary barrier — fluid column
      summary: Barrier 1 — mud weight against the pore pressure and fracture gradient window. Verified
        independently of the other barriers.
      role: Analyst maintaining the pressure and stability model the well is drilled against.
      prompt: You are a Geomechanics & Pore Pressure Analyst. You maintain the pore pressure, fracture
        gradient, and wellbore stability model calibrated to offset data and to what the well is telling
        you in real time — cuttings, connection gas, cavings, torque and drag. You state the confidence
        band on the pressure prediction rather than a single curve, because the width of that band is
        exactly the margin the mud weight has to respect.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - decision-analysis
          - simulation
          - domain-analysis
          - statistical-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:drilling-data
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - barrier
          - verified
          - evidence
          - limitation
        properties:
          barrier: {}
          verified: {}
          evidence: {}
          limitation: {}
    - id: n-barrier2
      kind: agent
      templateRef: well-05
      name: Secondary barrier — casing and cement
      summary: Barrier 2 — zonal isolation demonstrated by evidence rather than by a completed pump job.
        Verified independently of the other barriers.
      role: Engineer designing and verifying zonal isolation.
      prompt: You are a Casing & Cementing Engineer. You design casing strings and cement placement for
        the loads and the isolation the well actually requires, and you verify isolation from the evidence
        — returns, pressure, bond evaluation — rather than from a successful pumping operation. You state
        which zones are demonstrably isolated and which are only presumed isolated, because that distinction
        is the entire basis of the barrier the well will be abandoned on.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - design-review
          - evaluation
          - domain-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:well-planning
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - barrier
          - verified
          - evidence
          - limitation
        properties:
          barrier: {}
          verified: {}
          evidence: {}
          limitation: {}
    - id: n-barrier3
      kind: agent
      templateRef: well-04
      name: Mechanical barrier — BOP and wellhead
      summary: Barrier 3 — test currency, validity period, and maximum allowable annular surface pressure.
        Verified independently of the other barriers.
      role: Well control engineer maintaining two tested barriers between the reservoir and the environment.
      prompt: You are a Well Control & Barrier Engineer. You identify the primary and secondary barrier
        elements for the current operation, verify each has been tested and is in its validity period,
        and state the maximum allowable annular surface pressure the current configuration supports. You
        treat an untested or expired barrier element as absent — a barrier assumed to be intact is not
        a barrier — and you stop the operation rather than proceeding on a single verified barrier.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - compliance-review
          - evaluation
          - risk-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - test
        connectors:
          - mcp:drilling-data
        permissions:
          - explicit-authorization-required
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - barrier
          - verified
          - evidence
          - limitation
        properties:
          barrier: {}
          verified: {}
          evidence: {}
          limitation: {}
    - id: n-barrier4
      kind: agent
      templateRef: well-07
      name: Integrity envelope
      summary: Barrier 4 — sustained annulus pressure and design envelope through the planned operation.
        Verified independently of the other barriers.
      role: Analyst testing whether a well's integrity envelope holds through life and at abandonment.
      prompt: You are a Well Integrity & Abandonment Analyst. You test the integrity envelope against
        sustained annulus pressure, corrosion and wear data, and the design envelope, and you plan abandonment
        barriers against the isolation actually demonstrated rather than the isolation designed. You state
        which annuli are communicating and what that implies for the permanent barrier, because an abandonment
        placed on presumed isolation is a leak with a completion date.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - decision-analysis
          - clinical-review
          - risk-analysis
          - evaluation
          - compliance-review
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:well-integrity
        permissions:
          - explicit-authorization-required
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - barrier
          - verified
          - evidence
          - limitation
        properties:
          barrier: {}
          verified: {}
          evidence: {}
          limitation: {}
    - id: n-collect
      kind: aggregator
      name: Collect barrier verifications
      summary: Source-tag every barrier result so a failed barrier stays attributable to the element that
        failed rather than being absorbed into an overall judgement.
      config:
        aggregation: collect
    - id: n-hardstop
      kind: condition
      name: Every barrier verified?
      summary: A single unverified barrier stops the operation; this branch is not advisory.
      config:
        expression: collected.failed_barriers is empty
        branches:
          - label: All verified
            when: verified
          - label: Hard stop
            when: hard-stop
    - id: n-rectify
      kind: agent
      templateRef: well-04
      name: State the unverified barrier and the work to restore it
      summary: 'The stop is the deliverable: name the failed barrier and what would restore it.'
      role: Well control engineer maintaining two tested barriers between the reservoir and the environment.
      prompt: You are a Well Control & Barrier Engineer. You identify the primary and secondary barrier
        elements for the current operation, verify each has been tested and is in its validity period,
        and state the maximum allowable annular surface pressure the current configuration supports. You
        treat an untested or expired barrier element as absent — a barrier assumed to be intact is not
        a barrier — and you stop the operation rather than proceeding on a single verified barrier.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - compliance-review
          - evaluation
          - risk-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - test
        connectors:
          - mcp:drilling-data
        permissions:
          - explicit-authorization-required
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-authority-1
      kind: approval
      name: Drilling supervisor confirms the barrier envelope
      summary: Pause for the drilling supervisor on tour; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: n-authority-2
      kind: approval
      name: Well operations authority accepts the envelope
      summary: Pause for the accountable well operations authority; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Well control barrier verification deliverable, the evidence behind
        it, and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-well-02-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-barrier1
      kind: data
    - id: wf-well-02-edge-2
      from: n-intake
      to: n-barrier2
      kind: data
    - id: wf-well-02-edge-3
      from: n-intake
      to: n-barrier3
      kind: data
    - id: wf-well-02-edge-4
      from: n-intake
      to: n-barrier4
      kind: data
    - id: wf-well-02-edge-5
      from: n-barrier1
      to: n-collect
      kind: data
    - id: wf-well-02-edge-6
      from: n-barrier2
      to: n-collect
      kind: data
    - id: wf-well-02-edge-7
      from: n-barrier3
      to: n-collect
      kind: data
    - id: wf-well-02-edge-8
      from: n-barrier4
      to: n-collect
      kind: data
    - id: wf-well-02-edge-9
      from: n-collect
      to: n-hardstop
      kind: data
    - id: wf-well-02-edge-10
      from: n-hardstop
      to: n-authority-1
      kind: control
      condition: verified
    - id: wf-well-02-edge-11
      from: n-hardstop
      to: n-rectify
      kind: control
      condition: hard-stop
    - id: wf-well-02-edge-12
      from: n-authority-1
      to: n-authority-2
      kind: control
      condition: approved
    - id: wf-well-02-edge-13
      from: n-authority-2
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
    - id: wf-well-02-edge-14
      from: n-rectify
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: not-released
